 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Solid full-length divider lines define repeated tile bands.
    hdiv = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    vdiv = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) and len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]

    def segments(length, dividers):
        out = []
        start = 0
        for p in dividers:
            if start < p:
                out.append((start, p))
            start = p + 1
        if start < length:
            out.append((start, length))
        return out

    rs = segments(h, hdiv)
    cs = segments(w, vdiv)
    # With a pair of vertical boundaries the enclosed middle tile is the source;
    # otherwise use the upper/left tile. Likewise for horizontal partitions.
    sr = rs[len(rs)//2] if len(rs) == 3 else rs[0]
    sc = cs[1] if len(cs) == 3 else cs[0]
